summary: Diff adds a single-page React UI with deterministic frontend SVG logo generation, static/animated previews, export (SVG/PNG), and a Motoko backend to persist projects per authenticated user. Some acceptance-criteria details appear incomplete/incorrect based on the visible diff (notably animation speed control and restoring from saved specification).

missing_requirements.requirement: Speed control changes the animation timing in real time for the animated preview derived from the same logo specification.
missing_requirements.reason: The AnimatedLogoPreview exposes a speed slider, but it only calls onSpeedChange and restarts the SVG via a React key; there is no evidence the speed value is used to re-render the animated SVG string with new timing. The component even imports renderAnimatedSvg but does not use it, and it renders the passed-in svgString unchanged.

missing_requirements.requirement: Selecting an item from "My logos" restores the static and animated previews for that project (including using the saved logo specification).
missing_requirements.reason: Projects are saved with a logoSpecification in the backend, but the selection handler shown regenerates from project.description (comment says "Regenerate from the saved specification" but it does not use the saved specification). There is no evidence the UI restores the exact previously saved spec-driven SVGs.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile system and mandatory profile setup dialog (name capture) as part of authentication flow.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not request user profiles or a name-setup step; it only requires per-user project persistence and Internet Identity sign-in.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend features for marking projects as viewed and favoriting projects.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested in requirements; persistence requirement only mentions storing description/spec/timestamps and listing/reopening logos.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin-token/secret-based access-control initialization via URL parameter (caffeineAdminToken) and related authorization mixins.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested; BuildRequest only constrains backend to a single Motoko actor and allows Internet Identity, but does not specify an admin secret token mechanism.
